title: [Windows / Steam Deck] Ace of Hearts: Campus Volleyball – free career beta. Run a university team and play every match yourself
author: Think-Shoulder-4960
selftext:
Hi! I'm a solo dev and I'd love some fresh eyes on my career mode.



Ace of Hearts: Campus Volleyball is a colorful anime volleyball game. You run a Japanese university team, recruit players, plan each week of training and play the matches yourself with timing-based controls. A new team is clumsy and hard to play, and the goal is that you feel them getting better on the court.

Trailer: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oahvKaA5QII](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oahvKaA5QII)

Play it free: [https://tyr4ntx1.itch.io/ace-of-hearts-campus-volleyball](https://tyr4ntx1.itch.io/ace-of-hearts-campus-volleyball)



\- Free beta: one full career season, plus single match

\- Windows, or Steam Deck through Proton

\- Controller or mouse and keyboard

\- English and German

\- About 720 MB



What I'd most like to know:

1. Does career mode keep you playing week after week?

2. Can you feel your team improving?

3. Where did you get lost, and what felt unfair?



Expect rough edges. Feedback here or on Discord is very welcome: [https://discord.gg/uazeCWycCB](https://discord.gg/uazeCWycCB)



Transparency: music, sound effects, voices and the opening film use generative AI. All characters and events are fictional. All characters are 21 years of age or older.
